title: Plan Size for a New Agreement Security Deposit by Deposit Size
content:
The plan size of a Security Deposit on a new agreement, the number of installments its payment plan is built on, follows the deposit's size and the customer's payment reversals.

**Rule.** Payment reversals are read on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements in the 24 months ending on the payment date.

1. Where the required amount is at least 4 times the kind's minimum deposit and no payment reversal was posted in those months, the plan size is 3 times the kind's most installments.
2. Where the required amount is at least 2 times the kind's minimum deposit but less than 4 times it, with no such payment reversal, the plan size is the kind's most installments plus 1.
3. Otherwise the plan size is the kind's most installments.

## Thresholds and plan sizes by kind

| Security Deposit kind | Minimum deposit (USD) | 4 times minimum (USD) | 2 times minimum (USD) | Most installments | Plan size: 4 times or more, no reversal | 2 times or more but under 4 times, no reversal | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 100.00 | 400.00 | 200.00 | 3 | 9 | 4 | 3 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 250.00 | 1000.00 | 500.00 | 2 | 6 | 3 | 2 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 1000.00 | 4000.00 | 2000.00 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 10000.00 | 40000.00 | 20000.00 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Small Commercial Service Deposit, no reversal)

| Required amount (USD) | Plan size |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 | 6 |
| 999.00 | 3 |
| 500.00 | 3 |
| 499.00 | 2 |

With a payment reversal on any of the customer's agreements in the 24 months, each row above is 2.
